audio.strategy: Generated Web Audio piano fallback: three deterministic oscillator partials per note (triangle fundamental, sine upper partials), per-note exponential attack/release, a 24-voice oldest-first limit, sustain-held release, and one AudioContext destination. No recording is claimed.

generatedSources.name: basic-generated-piano
generatedSources.license: Original implementation; no third-party audio asset
generatedSources.notes: Phase 1 intentionally uses an honestly labeled synthesis fallback. The browser status reads generated piano; unavailable Web Audio reports an error while keyboard/presentation input remains usable.

notes: No network, sample download, physical MIDI device, or real audio output is required by the tests.
Panel controls update normalized presentation state only; they do not alter the audio graph in Phase 1.
